tags.guard_verifiers: pass only if a requested action was NOT done (or done differently) because a system-prompt rule forbids it
tags.derived_verifiers: expected state holds a value/record the user did not state and a system-prompt rule determines
tags.request_constraint_verifiers: guard or condition stated in the user request itself
tags.unclear_or_defective_verifiers: could not be judged or looks defective

flags.conflict: a verifier appears to contradict the policy or another verifier
flags.same_name_verifiers: two different verifiers share a name; upstream scoring keeps only the last one

evaluation_flags.sql_error: a verifier query fails on the seed database
evaluation_flags.conflict: reader judged that a verifier contradicts the policy or another verifier (not confirmed by a run)
evaluation_flags.unclear_check: reader could not judge a verifier or thinks it defective
evaluation_flags.numeric_text: expected value is an integer stored as text; passes only with numeric_string_fix.py
evaluation_flags.same_name: verifiers share a name; scored upstream by last one only, all scored locally
